title: Ryan's Ores N' Stuff
description: A simple mod I am making over the summer. It adds a brand spanking new resource, BOEREWORS!!!!
body:
# **What does this mod contain?**

*   Zenith Crystal Ore
*   Boerewors Ore
*   Zenith Crystal Tools
*   Ore Detector
*   Boerewors Rolls \[A nice food item\]

# **What is the point of this mod?**

Currently this mod aims to provide some end game content. Zenith Crystal ore can only be mined with netherite tools as well as Boerewors Ore can only be mined with Zenith Crystal tools. This provides a way of those in caves to have a steady supply of minable food.

# **What will be added in the future?**

I am currently working on a custom crafting/processing station called the "Webber" that is able to process boerewors other than using a furnace and blasting furnace

# **Suggestions**

If you have any suggestions on content that should be added please make a GitHub issue with your idea!

# **Bugs/Issues**

Please create an issue on the GitHub repository if you encounter any bugs
